scope: Descriptive structural audit, not a listening test or musical-quality score.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-pattern metrics, with population standard deviation in *_sd fields. Conditional metrics are null when their denominator is empty and excluded from means; *_eligible_patterns records the denominator of each mean.
tonic_triad_reference: C/Eb/G only. This is an explicit static C-minor test sonority, not the unknown track chords.

metrics.notes_per_bar: Note count divided by phrase length in four-beat bars.
metrics.empty_bar_pct: Percentage of all phrase bars containing no note onset.
metrics.bar_onset_jaccard: Intersection / union of bar-one/bar-two onset tick sets; ignores pitch and trailing duration.
metrics.exact_bar_rhythm_pct: 100 if the two bars have identical onset tick sets, else 0.
metrics.exact_bar_pitch_rhythm_pct: 100 if both bars have identical (onset tick, MIDI pitch) sets, else 0.
metrics.pitch_classes: Number of distinct pitch classes in the phrase.
metrics.pitch_range_semitones: Maximum MIDI pitch minus minimum MIDI pitch.
metrics.root_note_pct: Percentage of notes with selected tonic pitch class.
metrics.tonic_triad_note_pct: Percentage in C minor tonic triad C/Eb/G; a reference sonority, not known song harmony.
metrics.strong_nontriad_pct: Percentage of quarter-beat onsets outside C/Eb/G; no claim these notes are necessarily wrong.
metrics.nontriad_duration_pct: Percentage of total note duration outside C/Eb/G.
metrics.long_nontriad_count: Number of notes outside C/Eb/G lasting >=0.5 beat.
metrics.unresolved_nontriad_pct: Among nontriad notes, percentage lacking a following triad note 1–2 semitones away within 0.5 beat; descriptive neighbor-resolution rule.
metrics.leap_over_fifth_pct: Percentage of cyclic adjacent-note intervals exceeding seven semitones.
metrics.compound_leap_pct: Percentage of cyclic adjacent-note intervals exceeding twelve semitones.
metrics.loop_boundary_leap: Absolute semitone difference between last and first MIDI pitch.
metrics.second_bar_first_root_pct: 100 if first onset in second bar is tonic, else 0; 0 for empty bar.
metrics.final_note_triad_pct: 100 if final onset is C/Eb/G, else 0.
metrics.offbeat_eighth_pct: Percentage of onsets at half-beat positions between quarter pulses.
metrics.sixteenth_pct: Percentage at odd sixteenth positions (including swing).
metrics.variation_count_ratio: One same-control Variation count divided by original count.
metrics.variation_new_onset_pitch_pct: Percentage of Variation notes with no identical onset tick and MIDI pitch in original.
metrics.scale_violations: Count outside C natural minor; must remain zero for these unlocked settings.
metrics.repeat_lag1_onset_overlap_pct: Across all bar pairs 1 bars apart, 200 * shared onset ticks / total onsets in both sides. Null with no compared onsets. Bar-local onsets are rounded to 960 ticks/beat.
metrics.repeat_lag1_pitch_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 1 bars apart, percentage with equal MIDI pitch. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.
metrics.repeat_lag1_duration_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 1 bars apart, percentage with equal duration rounded to 960 ticks/beat. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.
metrics.repeat_lag1_velocity_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 1 bars apart, percentage with equal integer velocity. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.
metrics.repeat_lag1_full_note_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 1 bars apart, percentage with equal MIDI pitch, quantized duration, and integer velocity together. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.
metrics.repeat_lag2_onset_overlap_pct: Across all bar pairs 2 bars apart, 200 * shared onset ticks / total onsets in both sides. Null with no compared onsets. Bar-local onsets are rounded to 960 ticks/beat.
metrics.repeat_lag2_pitch_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 2 bars apart, percentage with equal MIDI pitch. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.
metrics.repeat_lag2_duration_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 2 bars apart, percentage with equal duration rounded to 960 ticks/beat. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.
metrics.repeat_lag2_velocity_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 2 bars apart, percentage with equal integer velocity. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.
metrics.repeat_lag2_full_note_retention_pct: Among shared-onset note pairs 2 bars apart, percentage with equal MIDI pitch, quantized duration, and integer velocity together. Null when there are no shared onsets; read alongside onset overlap, not as whole-phrase similarity.

cross_seed_metrics.distinct_first_bar_onset_motifs: Number of distinct first bar onset signatures across seeds in this condition. Onsets are rounded to the nearest sixteenth; durations, velocities, and seed IDs are excluded.
cross_seed_metrics.distinct_first_bar_pitch_onset_motifs: Number of distinct first bar (nearest-sixteenth onset, MIDI pitch) signatures across seeds in this condition. Durations, velocities, and seed IDs are excluded.
cross_seed_metrics.first_bar_pitch_onset_collision_pct: Percentage of unordered pairs of different seed indices having identical first bar pitch/onset signatures. Null with fewer than two seeds. Describes this sample, not the possible output space.
cross_seed_metrics.distinct_first_two_bar_onset_motifs: Number of distinct first two bar onset signatures across seeds in this condition. Onsets are rounded to the nearest sixteenth; durations, velocities, and seed IDs are excluded.
cross_seed_metrics.distinct_first_two_bar_pitch_onset_motif: Number of distinct first two bar (nearest-sixteenth onset, MIDI pitch) signatures across seeds in this condition. Durations, velocities, and seed IDs are excluded.
cross_seed_metrics.first_two_bar_pitch_onset_collision_pct: Percentage of unordered pairs of different seed indices having identical first two bar pitch/onset signatures. Null with fewer than two seeds. Describes this sample, not the possible output space.

comparison_limits: Use the same settings, bars, and seed count for comparisons. Diversity fields summarize a condition across seeds; they are not means of per-pattern measurements. Repetition and diversity are descriptive and do not establish musical quality or originality.
